sources_considered.why: Read the transcript and publication-date passage. It contains a contemporaneous company estimate of actual engineering productivity.
Read the abstract and version history. A controlled experiment supplies earlier corroborating context.
Read to verify that the experiment concerned summer 2024, rather than treating publication as the event date.
The page gives June 2025 without a publication day, and describes earlier experiments. It is unnecessary to the proposed result.

evidence_items.publisher: Lex Fridman Podcast; statement by Google's CEO
evidence_items.explanation: Pichai identifies the measure immediately beforehand as Google's engineering velocity improvement from AI, rather than the share of generated code. This contemporaneous company estimate supports the modest claim of some practical value.

The randomized study involved 96 Google engineers and estimated about a 21% reduction in time on a particular task. Its summer 2024 observations corroborate the existence of benefits historically but fall outside the current observation window.

unresolved_gaps: The contemporaneous company estimate does not disclose enough methodology here for independent replication.
